subtopics.title: Investment, Support and Charging
subtopics.summary: The policy plans total investment of approximately 15,000 crore. Government support is restricted exclusively to battery electric vehicles and not to hybrid vehicles. The plan includes installing over 30,000 public charging stations across Delhi. Financial support and investment is handled by the Delhi Transport Department, and infrastructure development by Delhi Transco Limited.
facts: Government support restricted exclusively to battery electric vehicles, not hybrid vehicles
Over 30,000 public charging stations planned across Delhi
Financial support and investment implemented by Delhi Transport Department
Infrastructure development implemented by Delhi Transco Limited
Key objective: strengthen charging and battery-swapping infrastructure
Key objective: encourage sustainable public and commercial transport

subtopics.title: National Schemes: NEMMP, FAME and PM E-DRIVE
subtopics.summary: Delhi's policy sits within national electric mobility efforts. The National Electric Mobility Mission Plan was launched in 2013, and the government committed to achieve 30% e-mobility by 2030. FAME India, launched by the Ministry of Heavy Industries & Public Enterprises, is part of that mission plan and offers subsidies for several vehicle types. PM E-DRIVE, launched in 2024 with the Ministry of Heavy Industries as nodal ministry, builds on FAME-II and the Electric Mobility Promotion Scheme 2024.
facts: National Electric Mobility Mission Plan launched in 2013
Government committed to achieve 30% e-mobility by 2030
FAME India launched by Ministry of Heavy Industries & Public Enterprises
FAME India is a part of the National Electric Mobility Mission Plan
FAME subsidy can be claimed for two-wheelers, three-wheelers, electric and hybrid cars and electric buses
PM E-DRIVE launched in 2024; scheme period 2024-2026
PM E-DRIVE nodal ministry: Ministry of Heavy Industries
PM E-DRIVE objectives: reduce upfront EV cost and expedite EV adoption
PM E-DRIVE objectives: establish public EV charging and promote EV manufacturing ecosystem
PM E-DRIVE builds on FAME-II and Electric Mobility Promotion Scheme 2024
